source: curated by hand (2026-11-13, agent-knowledge.md K2 batch b) with tools/jeskola_knowledge.py, from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-13 and the evidence listed
summary: An early Buzz bass synth: four voices of saw, pulse or triangle into a resonant filter, with slides between notes. For simple basses in old Buzz songs; Neo Poly is the modern one.
use_for: Simple four-voice analog-style bass with a resonant filter and note slides.
quirks: Four voices (the profile's note count), notes as written (no pitch offset).
Resonance near its top is very hot: +16 dBFS peak in the profile.
Volume and Slide lenght are pattern columns: Volume 128 is 100 percent, 254 about 198 percent; the profile found no level change from them with the others at their defaults.
Velocity does not change its level.
Closed source: names come from its own descriptions and measurements, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-13) — four voices, -9 LUFS for a note, hot with Resonance at its top

problems: hot (loud but steady) with Resonance at its maximum (128): +16.2 dBFS peak

swept_because: every parameter at its maximum at once: hot

Cutoff.evidence: silent at its minimum, sounding at the other end

track Waveform.evidence: a choice: its texts say what it is; no role measured

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.how: Sets the filter's corner on a 0 to 128 scale; 128 is fully open.
parameters.sound: Lower values close the filter and make the bass duller and quieter.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.how: Sets the emphasis at the cutoff on a 0 to 128 scale.
parameters.sound: Higher values add a squelchy peak; near the top it gets very loud, so check the level.

track_parameters.name: Waveform
track_parameters.how: Chooses the oscillator: 1 sawtooth, 2 pulse, 3 triangle.
track_parameters.sound: Saw is bright and buzzy, pulse hollow, triangle soft and round.

track_parameters.name: Volume
track_parameters.how: Sets a note's loudness on a 0 to 254 scale; 128 is 100 percent. It is a pattern column.
track_parameters.sound: Higher is louder; the measurement found no level change from it with the others at their defaults.

track_parameters.name: Slide lenght
track_parameters.how: Sets how many ticks a slide to the next note takes, 1 to 255 (the machine's own spelling of length).
track_parameters.sound: Longer slides glide the pitch more slowly between notes.
